finetuned.description:
Add an exquisite designer touch to your special brunch, dinner or cocktail party with ' decorative napkins. Our soft, triple-ply paper napkins come in 3 sizes - cocktail, guest/hostess and luncheon.

Coordinate with our other paper items in a wide array of stunning designs to create an elegant, festive mood. Created by Bruce & Deborah Michel in the early 1980s, ' paper goods, trays, tinware, and melamine allow you to set a beautiful table without a lot of fuss.

Best of all, they are as easy to care for as they are elegant. Making this kind of hospitality simple and fun is a big part of what we are all about.

And look beyond the dining table to fully experience the brand. We welcome you lather up with our English soaps, enjoy the ambiance of our scented candles and end your day with a wonderfully fragrant bubble bath.
